items.title: Browse Subfolders
items.description: Choose View → Include Subfolders to combine supported images from a folder and its subfolders. Filter a branch and its descendants in the folder tree, or search by name or relative path.

items.title: Text Without AI Insights
items.description: Extract and copy text even when AI Insights is off or Apple Intelligence is unavailable. Text stays available if a description fails. Recognition may contain errors; partial extraction is marked.

items.title: Restore and Refresh Your Collection
items.description: Restore your last accessible folder, selected image when available, sort, subfolder scope, filter, and search. Press ⌘R to find file changes while keeping your selection when that file is still available.

items.title: Clearer Image Insights
items.description: Shorter descriptions focus on visible content, and tall documents use a higher-resolution text pass. Check Again refreshes model readiness. Descriptions and recognized text may still contain errors.

items.title: Grid and Image Controls
items.description: Up and Down move by row in Grid, an outline marks the selection, and Return opens the image. Images appear during scanning, and copying images runs in the background.

items.title: More Reliable Folder Browsing
items.description: Folder switching and canceled scans recover more reliably, and trashed images stay out of older scan results. Returning to folder selection disables image commands while keeping your last selection.

items.title: Preserved Folder Access
items.description: Saved folder permissions can recover after a temporary disconnection during an update. Unavailable folders no longer block startup, and choosing another folder cancels an older restoration.

items.title: Insights Stay With the Image
items.description: Changed images no longer show their previous description or text during a reload. Image preparation shows progress and can be canceled before analysis or text extraction starts.
